title: Elementor 4.1.3 has no document/repeater/settings command
symptoms: elementor.getContainer throws Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'children') right after load
cause: Repeater rows are their own containers, and the editor's containers are not ready until the preview iframe builds, about 15 to 20 seconds after load.
fix: Wait for the current document's container, walk widget.repeaters[fieldName].children, and run document/elements/settings on each row. Save with document/save/default; the page is live immediately if published.
apply: await $e.run('document/elements/settings', { container: row, settings: { text: 'New' } }); await $e.run('document/save/default');
